threat_event: An attacker with a stolen support session reads every tenant's configuration and user lists through the support console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 460 support staff hold standing all-tenant read access; 12-hour sessions
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B II.B.3; III.C.1.a) (client banks' duties); 12 CFR 53.4
treatment_plan: Ticket-linked, tenant-scoped access; step-up; console activity review (POAM-008)

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect exposes one client's customers to another
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared application tier; isolation enforced in code and by schema
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B II.B.1) (client banks' duties)
existing_controls: Schema and key per tenant; isolation tests each release
treatment_plan: Independent isolation test each year; runtime tenant-context checks

threat_event: Business payment fraud at client tenants that switched off MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 client tenants allow password-only business payment users
existing_controls: Device binding; step-up for new beneficiaries
treatment_plan: Make business payment MFA mandatory in every tenant (POAM-009)

threat_event: A platform outage over 4 hours triggers notices to up to 212 client banks and service credits
A bank service provider notice is late or goes to the wrong people
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No bank-designated contact for 61 client banks; notice procedure not tied to the 4-hour clock
treatment_plan: Collect contacts; 4-hour timer in the incident tool (POAM-005)

threat_event: A compromised staff mailbox sends fake remittance changes to client banks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client-facing staff not trained on vendor impersonation; clients pay invoices on emailed instructions
treatment_plan: Vendor-impersonation training; remittance changes only through the client portal with callback

threat_event: Malicious code enters through the build pipeline
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.d) (client banks' duties)

threat_event: The cash-flow data service drives client credit decisions without developer documentation or fairness testing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sold to 64 client banks; no documentation of intended uses, limitations, or testing; not in the SOC 2 description
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Act Sec. 5); Colorado SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01, under counsel review); client banks' ECOA duties
treatment_plan: Developer documentation package; fairness and stability testing; add to SOC 2 description (POAM-015)

threat_event: Data service changes reach client banks without notice or SOC 2 description updates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Change gate does not cover attribute or model changes
treatment_plan: Route attribute and model changes through the change gate with client notice (POAM-014)

threat_event: Core conversion files with client customer data are kept or mishandled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files exchanged by email in 2025 conversions
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.4) (client banks' duties)
existing_controls: 30-day deletion with certificates in the workspace
treatment_plan: Block conversion files in email; secure exchange only

threat_event: Contract notice commitments (24 hours for 88 clients) are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commitments not in the notice register
treatment_plan: Add contract terms to the notice register (POAM-016)

regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.e) (client banks' duties)
existing_controls: PAM with just-in-time approval and recording
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Financial Software division CISO (Low)

threat_event: The coding assistant (AI-007) leaks code or secrets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enterprise terms bar training on group code
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Financial Software division CISO (Low)

threat_event: Credit union clients' notice terms do not line up with their own regulator reporting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credit unions are outside the Bank Service Company Act; oversight rests on contract
regulatory_driver: Client contracts; credit unions' own reporting duty (12 CFR 748.1(c))
treatment_plan: Offer the same notice terms to credit unions as to banks

threat_event: Offshore or foreign-person access to bulk client customer financial data
regulatory_driver: N51-R04 (DOJ Data Security Program, 28 CFR Part 202)
existing_controls: No offshore access in contracts; vendor screening
treatment_plan: Annual certification from vendors with data access

threat_event: Static service account keys for platform pipelines are stolen
Failover to the warm standby region does not work when needed
Security or AI claims in client marketing are not substantiated
treatment_plan: Legal and security review of all security and AI claims
